name: inventory-category-icon-cohesion
description: Verify all five Inventory category icons use one text-free procedural tile system with equal bounds, semantic glyphs, clean alignment, responsive scaling support, and intact category selection.

args.code:
local H=game:GetService('HttpService')
local function verifyCategoryIconRow(row,compact,scale)
 local expectedSize=(compact and 20 or 40)*scale
 local expectedVisible=not compact or row.buttonBounds.w>=90
 local sameSize=math.abs(row.iconBounds.w-expectedSize)<=.75 and math.abs(row.iconBounds.h-expectedSize)<=.75
 local b,i=row.buttonBounds,row.iconBounds
 local inside=i.x>=b.x-.5 and i.y>=b.y-.5 and i.x+i.w<=b.x+b.w+.5 and i.y+i.h<=b.y+b.h+.5
 local visibilityValid=row.iconVisible==expectedVisible
 local visibleBoundsValid=visibilityValid and (not expectedVisible or inside)
 local usableButton=row.buttonVisible and b.w>=43.99 and b.h>=43.99 and row.buttonTextFits and row.buttonSelectable and row.buttonActive
 local semantic=row.button and row.icon and row.frame and row.style and row.embeddedText==false and row.glyph and row.noRaster
 return {valid=semantic and sameSize and visibleBoundsValid and usableButton,expectedSize=expectedSize,expectedVisible=expectedVisible,
  sameSize=sameSize,inside=inside,visibilityValid=visibilityValid,visibleBoundsValid=visibleBoundsValid,usableButton=usableButton}
end
local function visible(object)
 if not object then return false end
 local node=object
 while node do
  if node:IsA('GuiObject') and not node.Visible then return false end
  if node:IsA('ScreenGui') and not node.Enabled then return false end
  node=node.Parent
 end
 return object:IsDescendantOf(game.Players.LocalPlayer.PlayerGui)
end
local function bounds(object)
 return object and {x=object.AbsolutePosition.X,y=object.AbsolutePosition.Y,w=object.AbsoluteSize.X,h=object.AbsoluteSize.Y} or {x=0,y=0,w=0,h=0}
end
local g=game.Players.LocalPlayer.PlayerGui:WaitForChild('PunchWallHUD')
local a=g:WaitForChild('PunchWallClientAutomation')
assert(a:Invoke('OpenInventory')~=nil,'Inventory did not open')
task.wait(.3)
local root=assert(g.GameMenu:FindFirstChild('FunctionalInventory'),'Inventory root missing')
local scaleObject=assert(root:FindFirstChild('InventoryScale',true),'Inventory scale missing')
local scale=scaleObject.Scale
local compact=root:GetAttribute('InventoryCompact')==true
assert(scale>=.75 and scale<=1.2 and root:GetAttribute('InventoryUIScale')==scale,'Inventory scale has not settled')
local expected={All='GridTile1',Fists='GlovePalm',Pets='PetEgg',Boosts='BoostBolt',Honor='HonorMedal'}
local rows,ok={},true
local firstWidth,firstHeight
for _,category in ipairs({'All','Fists','Pets','Boosts','Honor'}) do
 local button=root:FindFirstChild('Category'..category,true)
 local icon=button and button:FindFirstChild('CategoryIcon')
 local glyph=icon and icon:FindFirstChild('CategoryGlyph')
 local semantic=glyph and glyph:FindFirstChild(expected[category],true)
 local list=button and button.Parent:FindFirstChildWhichIsA('UIListLayout')
 local modeValid=list and list.FillDirection==(compact and Enum.FillDirection.Horizontal or Enum.FillDirection.Vertical)
 local row={category=category,button=button~=nil,icon=icon~=nil,frame=icon and icon:IsA('Frame') or false,
  style=icon and icon:GetAttribute('InventoryCategoryIconStyle')=='UnifiedProceduralGlyphV1' or false,
  embeddedText=icon and icon:GetAttribute('InventoryCategoryIconEmbeddedText'),glyph=semantic~=nil,
  noRaster=icon and icon:FindFirstChildWhichIsA('ImageLabel',true)==nil or false,
  buttonBounds=bounds(button),iconBounds=bounds(icon),iconVisible=visible(icon),buttonVisible=visible(button),
  buttonTextFits=button and button.TextFits==true or false,buttonSelectable=button and button.Selectable==true or false,
  buttonActive=button and button.Active==true or false,buttonText=button and button.Text or '',modeValid=modeValid==true}
 local observed=verifyCategoryIconRow(row,compact,scale)
 for key,value in pairs(observed) do row[key]=value end
 firstWidth=firstWidth or row.iconBounds.w firstHeight=firstHeight or row.iconBounds.h
 row.equalToPeers=math.abs(row.iconBounds.w-firstWidth)<=.5 and math.abs(row.iconBounds.h-firstHeight)<=.5
 ok=ok and row.valid and row.equalToPeers and row.modeValid
 table.insert(rows,row)
end
local result={ok=ok and #rows==5,count=#rows,compact=compact,scale=scale,rows=rows}
assert(result.ok,'Inventory category icon cohesion mismatch '..H:JSONEncode(result))
return H:JSONEncode(result)

steps.label: five category icons share equal text-free procedural tiles

args.code: local H=game:GetService('HttpService') local g=game.Players.LocalPlayer.PlayerGui.PunchWallHUD local a=g.PunchWallClientAutomation local root=g:FindFirstChild('InventoryRoot',true) or g local rows,ok={},true for _,category in ipairs({'All','Fists','Pets','Boosts','Honor'}) do assert(a:Invoke('SelectInventoryCategory',category)~=nil,'failed to select '..category) task.wait(.08) local button=root:FindFirstChild('Category'..category,true) local icon=button and button:FindFirstChild('CategoryIcon') local stroke=icon and icon:FindFirstChild('CategoryIconStroke') local row={category=category,state=button and button:GetAttribute('InventoryVisualState'),stroke=stroke and stroke.Thickness or 0,selected=button and button:GetAttribute('InventoryVisualState')=='Selected' and stroke and stroke.Thickness==2} ok=ok and row.selected table.insert(rows,row) end local result={ok=ok and #rows==5,count=#rows,rows=rows} assert(result.ok,'Inventory category selection cohesion mismatch '..H:JSONEncode(result)) return H:JSONEncode(result)
